name: PartyOrder
description: Give the whole party an order.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for members of your Nether's Follower Framework party. One action for the party-wide orders (it replaces EveryoneWait, EveryoneFollow, GatherParty, RelaxHere and PartyLoot). Needs Advanced Actions on in Mantella. wait and follow act on the followers near you (within about 30 m); gather also moves a following member 2000 to 8192 units away and out of sight right behind you. Followers waiting farther away stay put.

order.description: follow or wait: everyone near the player (follow also ends relax); gather: come to the player; relax: rest nearby while the player stays; loot_on or loot_off: loot bodies and containers nearby.

prompt: If the player gives the whole party an order, begin your response with '{key}:'
